title: The Eight Paths to Life and Gehenna
description: Out of the cosmic Zone draw forth ten paths: a chosen company (four) reckoned to the Light, ascending up to life through the ships; and a parallel company of mingled and Error-bound paths drawing down to Gehenna. The descending paths operate through four works against the Cross of Light: lawlessness, killing, the wounding word, and blasphemy that mocks the gods.
